criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame a rendered place under one sky with scatter and shadows, frame 1 the strongest. Most frames read as a game engine render. Frame 2's person a mannequin on a flat pad, frame 4's near units flat black squares and a column of black boxes down the aisle, frame 5 a plain page on a flat olive door with a hard split to the sky, frame 9's ridge a jagged dark mass, frames 7 and 8 diagrams more than pictures.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, one hero, one accent. Both declared devices work, 7 to 8 is the before and after. Frame 5 sits outside the run. Frame 9's cut earns the close.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. Frame 9 merges c45's 1118 protestors with c44's resident comment. The block omits the caption's c46 and c20 ids though the documents are listed. 'One customer.' scoped only by the dek. The two judges never named as SOAH administrative law judges.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, where, who, the findings, the condition, the deciding body and a date land. No route to file a comment, the money appears on no slide, 'other customers' never translated to ratepayers.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, frame 2 pays, 7 to 8 is a real turn, frame 9 closes on a date. Frame 3 repeats the cover.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and plain, house rules clean. 'a condition on who pays' and 'the statute's test' register flat. Texas specificity stops at the county.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Palette, desert world and fence timeline fresh. Second consecutive PUCT docket, the yard close to no. 32's.

one_sentence_fix: Put the money on the slides and a comment route on frame 9, naming the judges as SOAH administrative law judges.
